I hear you, and that makes a lot of sense. When you’ve been let down before, it’s hard to trust the next purchase.

A few things about Heirloom that might help:

We grow our own plants at our nurseries in Oregon instead of buying from third parties, so we control the quality from start to finish.
Roses are own-root in 1-gallon containers (not bare root), which makes them longer-lived and more resilient over time.
We stand behind what we ship with a one-year guarantee on roses and a quality guarantee right at delivery for everything.
